# Support

## Support status

| Branch | Status |
|--------|--------|
| `main` (v2) | actively developed and supported |
| `v1` | frozen: final release 1.5.0 (2026-11-09), no security fixes |

The v1 branch keeps the MLA v1 format readable: pinned toolchain, vendored
dependencies. It will not receive security fixes. Migrate v1 archives to v2
with `mlar-upgrader` (see the README). If a v1 archive cannot be read, open
an issue against `main`.

## Questions and usage issues

Open a [GitHub issue](https://github.com/ANSSI-FR/MLA/issues).

## Security vulnerabilities

Do not open a public issue for security vulnerabilities. See
[SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) for coordinated disclosure.
